explanation: Total energy jumps from ~2569 J at step 37 to ~3770 J at step 38 (+1200 J) with controller disabled (work 0), exceeding E0+10%+5. At step 37 bodies 0 (m~19.8) and 1 (m~0.45) are in near-contact (gap 0.023) with high substep count (14, fast motion). The impulse + positional correction for the heavy-light pair with restitution ~0.84/0.55 appears to inject energy rather than dissipate. Setting e=0 removes the gain, confirming restitution handling in unequal-mass collisions as cause.
vision_note: In the lower right, two small bodies drift together until they are nearly touching at step 37. At step 38 they snap apart into a vertical stack with a sudden increase in separation, indicating an abrupt collision kick while the large body at top left stays essentially still.
